priorities.finding: Request context was the only train-only screened group with a positive primary lift (+0.00221) and full coverage, but the attempted tab×hour interaction did not validate: experiment 2 primary was 0.60065, down 0.00078 from experiment 1 despite a predicted +0.003 gain. Under the strict early-stopping rule, this is insufficient stable within-user ranking evidence to fund another request-context interaction iteration.
priorities.recommended_action: Stop feature experimentation rather than launch a follow-up. Retain already-deployed leakage-safe request-context main effects only if they are part of the current model; do not add further tab/hour crosses without new independent train-only evidence.

priorities.finding: The principal post-score weakness is top-five ranking on request surfaces, especially tab 8 (GAUC 0.0926 and nDCG@5 0.0238), tab 5 (GAUC 0.25 and nDCG@5 0.1063), and the large tab 0 slice (13,726 rows; nDCG@5 0.0633). Rare and medium-frequency items also have weak nDCG@5 (0.1717 and 0.2450), although medium-frequency GAUC is strong (0.7128). This GAUC/nDCG@5 separation indicates that some segments have usable broad within-user ordering but poor top-five placement; it is a diagnostic issue, not evidence that another tab×hour feature will help.
priorities.recommended_action: Treat tab-specific and item-frequency findings as monitoring and future data-collection targets. Do not use official-validation segments to select another feature experiment under the stopping rule.

avoid: Do not use current-impression outcome fields, including click, like, follow, comment, long-view, play-time, or stay-time signals; they are unavailable at ranking time and constitute leakage.
Do not use quarantined aggregate video-statistic snapshot features without per-impression availability timestamps.
Do not retry tab×hour or expand to higher-order request-context crosses after experiment 2 missed its predicted gain.

Do not promote screened groups with negative training-only lift: user_profile, historical_user_author_affinity, upload_recency, content_duration, item_metadata, historical_author_response, or historical_item_response.
metric_diagnosis: Experiment 2 has reasonable global within-user ranking (GAUC 0.6656) but weaker top-five quality (nDCG@5 0.5357), with concentrated tab and item-frequency failures. The low-GAUC tabs 8 and 5 are genuine ranking failures, while medium-frequency items illustrate that favorable GAUC can coexist with poor top-five ranking. Validation-label-defined user_positive_count=zero is retrospective-only and must not drive ranking features. The observed primary decline versus experiment 1 triggers early stopping; no available evidence supports additional budget.
